name: Environmental Healthcare Organization
description: A women-led, youth-led climate NGO based in Lahore, Pakistan, working with schools and communities since 2024.
mission: To build climate awareness and practical skills among young people in Pakistan through hands-on education, community action, and digital outreach.
vision: A Pakistan where every young person understands their environment and has the skills to protect it.

coreValues.title: Inclusion and quality education
coreValues.description: Every student, regardless of background, gets access to practical climate knowledge.

coreValues.title: Innovation and collaboration
coreValues.description: We work with schools, NGOs and community groups to find new ways to teach and act.

coreValues.title: Resilience and sustainability
coreValues.description: We prepare communities for climate risks and build habits that last.

method: School and camp visits with hands-on activities
Collaboration with schools, NGOs and community groups
Digital outreach through podcasts and social media
Equal involvement of girls and marginalised groups
